def test_plan_hours_match_summary_on_noisy_track(make_track):
    from trailhead.report import summarise

    track = make_track(*[(0, i * 0.01, 1000 + (2 if i % 2 else 0)) for i in range(40)])
    days = split_days(track, max_hours_per_day=100)
    assert sum(d[3] for d in days) == pytest.approx(summarise(track).hours, abs=0.01)
